title: A no-break space inside a credential
summary: A synthetic SendGrid-shaped key with one no-break space (U+00A0) inside it, a visible gap in an assignment.
rationale: A no-break space is whitespace-like: a reader may take the text as one token with a space-like character inside or as two tokens, as with a literal line feed. It is moved out of the case that holds the combining-mark and fullwidth variants, which stay undecided, so that this decision is not read onto them.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, ADR 0019 item 4 (#96)): expect it to be flagged. One value with an inserted gap, following the #95 fragment policy: the span is the whole text including the no-break space, and its decoded value (U+00A0 stripped) is the authored base, the same form the zero-width-space fixtures use. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history.

sources.supports: The key is documented as always 69 characters; the alphabet and 22/43 segment split are tool-corroborated, not this citation. Context only: it does not mention Unicode.
